Optional fields sqlite

Optional fields and optional query filters, from one Article schema

Create ArticleService.Create — optional fields may be sent or left out

Read GetByID and GetBySlug — the id is a uuid from logic.NewUUID

Update and delete Update replaces the whole entity, so omitted optional fields become NULL

List and filter ListByAuthor takes one required filter, the faceted search adds optional ones

What's happening:
Every button calls the Go server through Connect-Web using the TypeScript types in ent/gen/ts. Optional DSL fields become optional proto fields, so an unset field is absent from the message instead of arriving as 0 or "" — the log lists which ones came back NULL. The filter checkboxes pick which optional facets are sent at all, and metadata is a field.JSON, validated before the handler runs.
